# access_log

Changes access logging for the requests in its scope. The access log never includes header values, so there is nothing to redact.

| | |
|---|---|
| Runs | after the response is sent |
| Default priority | 100 (higher runs earlier) |
| Attach to | a route, a service, a workspace, or every request (`global`, system workspace only) |
| Switch off everywhere | flag `plugin_access_log` set to `false` |

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | When false, requests in this scope are not logged. |
| `sample_rate` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` | The share of requests logged, from 0 to 1. |
| `custom_fields` | object | `{}` | Field name to a template. Written as one JSON object in the line's custom field. |

## When to use it

To change logging for part of your traffic: silence a noisy health-check route, sample a very busy one, or add fields of your own to its lines. The destination of the access log is set once for the gateway, by the `access_log` setting; this plugin adjusts it per scope.

## Examples

Do not log health checks:

```yaml
version: 1
services:
  - name: api
    backends:
      - target: "10.0.0.38:8080"
routes:
  - name: health
    service: api
    paths:
      - { type: exact, value: /healthz }
    plugins:
      - type: access_log
        config:
          enabled: false
```

Log one request in a hundred on a busy route, with the workspace and the API version on each line:

```yaml
version: 1
services:
  - name: events
    backends:
      - target: "10.0.0.39:8080"
routes:
  - name: ingest
    service: events
    paths: [/ingest]
    plugins:
      - type: access_log
        config:
          sample_rate: 0.01
          custom_fields:
            tenant: "{{ workspace.slug }}"
            api_version: "{{ request.header.x-api-version | default(\"1\") }}"
```

## What is logged

One JSON line per request: time, request id, trace id, method, host, path, status, sizes, durations, route, service, backend, workspace, consumer, client address, retries, cache result, error code. Header values are never logged. See [observability](../../guides/observability.md).
